blocks.text: MASINLOC, Zambales — Protecting a 7,558-hectare marine and coastal landscape requires more than enforcing environmental laws. It also means working with communities, creating livelihood opportunities, and building partnerships to sustain conservation efforts. For Donaver Guevarra, community environment and natural resources officer (CENRO) of Masinloc, Zambales, these efforts have been central to protecting the Masinloc and Oyon Bay Protected Landscape (MOBPLS), earning him the 2026 Outstanding Regional Forester of the Year Award for Central Luzon.
